TRENDING [...] Frankfurt reached the semi-final of the inaugural competition last season, and they will now hope to go further. Niko Arnautis' side will face PSV in a game between teams currently sitting third in their respective leagues.

Frankfurt and PSV also met in the same stage last season as the German side won the tie with a 5-2 aggregate scoreline. The return leg will be played in Frankfurt on November 10th.
